Tony digs out a rare Mustang that's been hidden under dusty boxes for decades, but the owner has another surprise in store. Then Tony gets a chance to size up a Model A truck at an auction preview before he heads to the famous Spring Carlisle.
A Hurst Oldsmobile emerges from years in storage and roars back to life in the shop  a cold call takes Tony to a Chevelle project that creates more questions.

Tony helps prep a quirky, rare British TVR for sale and makes a play for one of the most elusive Camaros ever built, the legendary ZL1. When Tony is offered a rust-free '55 Chevy he knows it's too good of a deal to pass up.

When a client puts out the call for a DeLorean, Tony finds two different contenders: one showroom-clean, the other frozen in time  it's nostalgia versus perfection as Tony helps figure out what's the best route for his client to take.

Tony helps an owner move a custom Mercury to none other than Joe Zolper as a potential buyer  a lead sends Tony to a dusty garage hiding a nearly untouched Porsche RS America with just 5,000 original miles.

Tony teams up with the Auto Archeologist, Ryan Brutt, to uncover one of the rarest Dodge Demons in existence. Then Tony follows the trail to make an offer on a movie-star, an Eleanor Mustang. With this deal, the sky's the limit!
